variety_description: Early maturity, semi-tall, medium bold, variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland growing conditions. Climate resilient variety is developed by BRRI as a direct derivative from an IRRI line IR82589. It was released in 2015 for planting in Aman season. Drought tolerant with Strong culm. Recommended for growing in Aus season also. Non-lodging.
